description: Short-horizon free fall of a Gaussian MPM body. Center-of-mass position and velocity are compared with the constant-gravity solution while bounding volume and deformation-gradient health detect state corruption.

pass_criteria.quantity: free-fall center-of-mass trajectory and state health

provenance.notes: Ten-percent dynamics tolerance accommodates the released Physics3D grid damping over the short native rollout; the half-gravity intervention remains far outside it.
